meta.name: Kickback
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.76 KB

An all-action footbal-style game in your own home
You are controlling the player at the bottom of the screen. You can move down, left and right, or even up as far as the twenty-five yard line.
Your aim is to kick the oval-shaped ball, knock out the players in the middle of the screen, and then score by avoiding the intelligent and rapidly moving goalkeeper.
Some of the players will disappear when you hit them, but others will deflect the ball back at surprising angles.
However, all will score you points. Can you reach the ball and 'kick it back' before it leaves the field of play ?
This is an exciting game with five skill levels. You'll be hooked and glues to the screen until you can once again beat the high score.

meta.name: Kid Grid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.90 KB

Kid Grid is a one player game where the goal is to capture squares to gain points and complete a grid, in order to move to another level. Your character is Kid Grid and your main attributes are maneuverability and a stun gun, to be used against an array of 4 pursuers, whose task is to corner and kill you. The stun gun instantly, but only briefly, freezes the pursuers, allowing the Kid to elude them to continue building the grid. There is an allowance of 3, 5,or 7 stuns allowed depending on the difficulty of the level you're on, and unused stuns are allowed to accumulate as you progress, for use later in the game. Question marks will appear in the course of the game and are valuable assets to capture for points, and the player's point score is lowered if the question mark escapes. There are 5 levels of difficulty, and the player begins with 5 lives. If 10,000 points is reached, another life is allowed. Scoring is as follows: completing a square: 100 points, capturing a Question mark: 100-500 points, and not capturing a question mark: 10 point penalty.

meta.name: Kikstart
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.43 KB

This motorcycling stunt game is complete with simultaneous split screen two player action. You also have the option to test your skills in a one player game against the clock. The object of the game is to guide your rider as quickly and carefully as possible through three out of the eight courses you get to choose from before each race. The C16 version has 16 courses that have to be done in order with five lives. Every course has its own level of difficulty and a unique layout of trees, car's, bus's and pools of water for you to avoid by jumping your bike over. You can use your joystick or keyboard to accelerate, decelerate, wheelie and jump your bike from start to finish.

meta.name: King Of The Ring
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.48 KB

In King of the Ring, you are the manager of a boxer. It is your task to guide your fighter through four fights before taking on the world champion. You must use your skill to select the correct training strategy and tactics to guide your boxer to victory. All decisions you make afffect critically the fight you see on the screen. It should be your aim to challenge an opponent who you consider better than your last one. Doing this will significantly enhance your chance of defeating the world champion.

meta.name: Kissin' Kousins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.68 KB

The player controls a small character who can move horizontally, and can jump a short distance to avoid objects. The player also has a gun that can shoot a short distance. The player must traverse a number of screens of dangerous objects, including: bombers, caterpillars, kangaroos, rubber frogs, and toadstools. If the player strikes an enemy, they lose a life, and must restart that screen. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

meta.name: Klatwa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.18 KB

Klątwa ("The Curse") is an animated adventure game that takes place in an evil sorcerer's castle. The player moves around its rooms, collects objects and solves puzzles. The goal of the game is to get rid of the sorcerer and lift the curse from the land.
The player points to objects and elements of the scenery and chooses actions such as "Get", "Use", "Open" and so on. Each object or background element can have different actions available. The main character can carry up to five objects in his inventory and is also able to write down nine spells that can be used with nine different objects.

meta.name: Knight Lore
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.15 KB

The game Knightlore is set in a dark castle where you, the sabreman have to rid yourself from the curse of the werewolf. meta.name: Last Starfighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.66 KB

The Last Starfighter was a prototype game being developed as a tie-in release to the movie of the same name. When the movie performed poorly, the game was withheld, and then later repurposed and renamed into "Star Raiders II".
The modifications from Starfighter to the Star Raiders universe was relatively limited; star bases were added as the only way to repair damage, as well as a secondary source of energy (the star remained as a primary fueling point). The Frontier was removed, and the command ships that were originally intended to attack it became additional powerful enemies. Shields were added to the player's ship, and a new "tactical scanner" was added that displayed status information about the fighter in a single overview. Names of the ships and planets were changed, with most of them names from the original Star Raiders being used or adapted. The original animated introduction, similar to one seen in the movie, was removed, and a simple "Star Raiders II" copyright splash-screen was put in its place.

En este juego encarnas a un astronauta al que el Control de Misión pide que envíe un cohete a un asteroide y lo haga explotar antes de que llegue a la Tierra. El problema es el siguiente: no se puede encontrar el asteroide sin un plan de vuelo. Este primer juego de aventuras es muy corto y para completar la tarea el juego requiere que introduzcas comandos de una o dos palabras para realizar diversas acciones. La partida puede guardarse en cualquier momento del juego.

meta.name: Molecule Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.19 KB

Molecule Man es un juego isométrico de laberintos. La única forma de escapar del laberinto es usar el teletransportador, pero sólo puedes usarlo después de haber recogido las dieciséis secciones de la placa de circuitos del nivel. Para reducir la dosis de radiación, también debes tomar pastillas periódicamente. Empiezas el juego con veinte de estas pastillas, pero rápidamente se te acabarán y tendrás que buscar en el laberinto máquinas expendedoras de pastillas antirradiación. Pero, por supuesto, necesitas dinero para usar estas máquinas. Así que también tienes que recoger las monedas esparcidas por los alrededores. Se pueden recoger bombas para destruir secciones de la pared y acceder a otras salas.

meta.name: Monster Smash!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.61 KB

Monster Smash is a side view single screen platformer where your task is to capture all the monsters that are partying around the local graveyard. The screen has four rows of platforms containing four gravestones on three of the levels and part of the platforms can be turned 90°. The partying monsters appear from the top and left of the screen and move to the right of the screen along the platforms. Turning the platforms makes the monsters move downwards when they hit the turned parts and head to the bottom of the screen. Pressing the fire button makes the gravestones move up and down and when a monster hits a gravestone then they are captured. If the monster hits the other side of the screen then they have escaped and let too many escape, shown by a gauge, then it is game over. Once a certain amount of monsters have been captured then you move to the next level.

En Montezuma's Revenge eres un cazador de tesoros llamado Panama Joe, cuyo objetivo es encontrar un antiguo tesoro escondido por un guerrero azteca en lo mas profundo de las catacumbas. Pero ojo, las catacumbas son un laberinto habitado por horribles monstruos. Te esperan calaveras que rebotan y ruedan, arañas, cadenas que desaparecen y fuegos. Tendrás que encontrar las llaves y desbloquear las puertas para lograr tu objetivo. Panama Joe puede saltar y subir escaleras, pero no tiene mucho que ofrecer en cuanto a combate. Es por eso que debes evitar los monstruos en el juego: una colisión con un enemigo provoca la muerte inmediata.

Ataca las instalaciones enemigas en la luna... tu objetivo es destruir tantas instalaciones de superficie como sea posible. Cuantos más objetivos destruyas, mayor será la resistencia que opondrán los cazas enemigos y los misiles guiados.

meta.name: Moon Patrol (avalon Hill)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.12 KB

Nimno Rusterk (ace pilot) put thrusters on full, dodged beneath the enemy missiles and fired another burst at the descending alien. This time it fails to avoid the explosion, just in time to come under fire from two more green alien landers. In a furious firefight he obliterates one on the way down and hits the second as it skims the ground, trying to land.
Moon Patrol is an exciting solitaire or two-player game of fast action and split-second decisions. You can play at four different levels of difficulty. Your mission is to destroy as many as possible of the alien ships without being destroyed yourself. You receive five patrol ships armed with photon torpedoes to help you achieve your mission. If your ship survives one wave of aliens, you must land it to refuel for the next wave, or your craft will run out of fuel and crash.

meta.name: Moonbase Io
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.24 KB

La idea detrás de Moonbase Io (pronunciado ai-ou) se inspiró en los vuelos de los Voyager 1 y 2, que tomaron fotografías detalladas de Júpiter y sus lunas.

meta.name: Moon Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.87 KB

Moon Patrol es un juego de desplazamiento lateral en el que el jugador debe conducir un buggy lunar de una estación a otra, evitando estrellarse o ser destruido por naves alienígenas. El vehículo se mueve constantemente hacia la derecha y el jugador puede acelerar o reducir la velocidad, saltar y disparar. Hay 25 puntos de control a lo largo del camino, cada uno señalados con una letra de la A a la Z. Cada cinco puntos de control marcan una "etapa" separada dentro del recorrido; Llegar al final de una etapa por debajo del limite de tiempo otorga grandes bonificaciones de puntuación. Los peligros en la Luna incluyen rocas que pueden destruirse en pedazos o saltarse, pozos que deben saltarse, ovnis que disparan al jugador o bombardean el suelo (creando mas pozos), tanques estacionarios que disparan misiles, minas terrestres, plantas carnívoras que emergen de los pozos y cohetes que acechan al buggy por detrás antes de lanzarse hacia adelante en un intento de destruirlo.

meta.name: Mountain King
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.38 KB

Your goal is to retrieve the crown. For this, you need to collect enough diamonds to earn 1,000 points and after you need to locate the flame spirit. Since the mine is rather dark, you carry a flashlight with you which can be used to locate objects. Once you have the flame spirit, you need to find the entrance to the temple the crown is in. Offer the flame spirit to the skull spirit guarding the entrance, and you can get in and take the crown. Once you have the crown, you need to make it to the top of the mine before time runs out. Numerous cave bats fly around which can steal the crown. At the very bottom of the mine is a deadly spider, if you're not careful while exploring this region of the mine, you could become caught in it's web and be eaten. Each level has a time limit, and the more levels you complete the shorter the time limit becomes!

meta.name: Mouse Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.10 KB

This platform game challenges the player to guide a mouse around a screen collecting goodies - varying from cheese to cakes to balloons. Once they have all been collected you must reach the door, doing all of this within the time limit, depicted by a picture of a diffusing bomb. The player will have to jump over flowers, dodge bouncing balls and dinosaurs amongst other things - contact with any of these loses a life. Movement is achieved along ledges, via clouds, moving platforms and up ladders. Short falls can be withstood, but larger ones (or heavy landings from jumps) are fatal.

meta.name: Movie Musical Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.46 KB

Featuring the musical band the Jazz Scats, the player creates a music video for the band. The player chooses a band member, and then places a variety of props on the scene. The player can choose from a variety of musical scores to accompany the scene. The player then can move their chosen character throughout the animated scene as music plays. Items, props, and music are chosen from a number of menus represented by dots at the top and bottom of the screen. Movies can be saved and reviewed at a later date.

p: Mr Robot and His Robot Factory.zip
n: Mr Robot and His Robot Factory

meta.name: Mr. Robot And His Robot Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.42 KB

El robot se mueve con el teclado o un joystick, y puede hacerlo caminar de lado a lado, subir y bajar y saltar, recogiendo las píldoras blancas de las plataformas en el proceso. El jugador comienza con cuatro robots y pierde uno si cae demasiado o toca a cualquiera de los enemigos de bola de fuego. Cuando se recoge uno de los anillos blancos pulsantes dispersos por el nivel, el robot se vuelve temporalmente invulnerable y puede tocar con seguridad las bolas de fuego, destruyéndolas.
En cada nivel, el jugador comienza con 100 unidades de energía y pierde unidades a una velocidad de aproximadamente una por segundo, lo que hace que la finalización rápida de cada nivel sea importante. Cuando se agota la energía, el jugador pierde un robot.

meta.name: Mr. Cool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.80 KB

You as a cube jump on the pyramid built with color-changing platforms. You have to make all platforms of the same color, but the flying comets disturb you. But if the comets became the balls then cube can collect them painlessly.

meta.name: Mr. Dig
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.74 KB

Mr Dig is based on the arcade game Mr. Do! where you have to collect all the cherries over various single screen levels to move to the next level. As you move through the tunnels or dig through the dirt there are various nasties chasing you, but they can only move through tunnels and can't dig. To stop them you can either throw a bouncing ball where only one can be thrown at a time, or remove the dirt below an apple and make it fall on top of them. If you are touched by a nasty then you lose one of five lives and when all are gone it's game over. Before you play you can select a skill level from 1 to 9.

meta.name: Mr. Do!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.50 KB

You control Mr. Do has he tries to harvest all of the cherries on the screen. However, there are numerous bad guys out to get him! Mr. Do can defend himself from the badguys in two ways: first he can push the apples located throughout the playfield on top of the enemies and crush them. Secondly, Mr. Do is armed with a power ball. This can be thrown to destroy an enemy. Mr. Do has only one power ball, though, so he will need to wait for it to return to him before it can be used again. From time to time an alpha monster will appear on the screen bearing one of the letters in EXTRA. If you use the power ball to destroy an alpha monster you earn that letter; when you've earned the complete word EXTRA you receive an extra life. When you successfully collect all of the cherries, you will move on to the next, more difficult level.

meta.name: Mr. Do's Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.14 KB

Mr. Do!'s Castle is an action platform game, you are in a castle with several floors. You are Mr. Do! the clown who has a hammer which can be used to knock out the blocks in the floor. Wandering throughout the castle are deadly unicorns which are constantly trying to catch you. Your goal is to earn as many points as possible and to progress through the increasingly difficult castles. There are two ways to complete a castle; you can either destroy all of the deadly unicorns by crushing them with blocks, or you can knock out all of the blocks which have a cherry symbol on them. In addition to the cherry blocks, there are three blocks with a key. If all three key blocks are knocked out, the door on the roof of the castle unlocks. If you make it to the door, all of the unicorns will temporarily become harmless and will contain a letter. If you hit a letter unicorn, you will earn a letter in the word EXTRA. Spell the complete word, and you will earn an extra life. The last type of block you'll encounter has a skull on it. If you knock out two skull blocks, all of the blocks between them will also be knocked out and replaced with a bridge.

meta.name: Mr. Tnt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.42 KB

Mr. TNT is an arcade game where the player controls the titular blobby character. The game is played on a grid and the player's objective is to collect sixteen stockpiles of dynamite. Lit fuses are also moving across the grid and the player has to avoid touching these or he will explode. The grid is removed as the player or the fuses move across it which means the player can't turn around and move in the opposite direction. It also means that he has to plan his movements to avoid reaching a dead end. The same is true for the fuses who will burn out when reaching a dead end. A level is cleared when the player has collected all the dynamite or when all fuses have been burned out. The player then moves on to another level with a different grid layout. Points are earned by picking up dynamite and for crossing grid junctions.

meta.name: Ms. Pac-man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.89 KB

En 1982, se introdujo una secuela de Pac-Man en forma de su novia, Ms. Esta secuela continuaba la jugabilidad original, pero añadía nuevas características para mantener fresco el título.
Pac-Man intenta superar cuatro desafiantes laberintos llenos de puntos y frutas que rebotan sin cesar, evitando al mismo tiempo a Inky, Blinky, Pinky y Sue. Un toque de cualquiera de estos fantasmas significa perder la vida para Ms.

meta.name: Mugwump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.67 KB

One-player grid search game. You've been mugwump hunting all weekend. They're in nature's perfect hideout, but to give you a fighting chance to find them, we've transformed their hideout into a ten-by-ten grid. You track down the mugwumps by entering numbers on the keyboard representing horizontal and vertical coordinates on the grid.

meta.name: M.U.L.E.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.04 KB

Ambientado en el planeta ficticio Irata (Atari al revés), el juego es un ejercicio de economía, oferta y demanda, que implica la competencia entre cuatro jugadores, los huecos sobrantes se rellenan con oponentes de IA. Los jugadores eligen la raza de su colono, que tiene ventajas y desventajas las cuales pueden combinarse con sus respectivas estrategias.
El elemento central del juego es la compra y el uso de M.U.L.E.s (autómatas destinados a varias tareas), para desarrollar y recolectar recursos de los bienes del jugador. Dependiendo de cómo esté equipado, un M.U.L.E. se puede configurar para recolectar energía, comida, metal (a partir del cual se construyen los M.U.L.E.) y Crystite (un mineral valioso disponible solo en el nivel "Torneo").
Cada recurso va relacionado con las acciones en cada turno. Por ejemplo, si un jugador tiene poca comida, tendrá menos tiempo de juego en su turno.

meta.name: Musical Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.82 KB

Pilot a plane through musical notes. Each note is represented by a balloon, and you're trying to pop each balloon by flying through it. You have to use your joystick to aim your plane higher and lower so you don't fly above or below the balloons.

meta.name: My First Alphabet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.64 KB

My First Alphabet is a unique teaching book. At the touch of a key, you'll see a parade of colorful, artistically designed graphics pictures, each one representing a letter of the alphabet or number.

meta.name: Mychess II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.53 KB

Mychess II Is an early chess game for multiple platforms, and the sequel to Mychess. Games can be played 2-player or versus the computer. Players must type in their individual move commands, and only legitimate moves are allowed. Players can set up individual chess challenges, replay famous games from history, and can set time limits between moves for tournament play. Gameplay can be displayed in text-only mode, in a traditional 2D view, or in 3D mode.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #01 - Golden Baton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.59 KB

Your mission is to retrieve the Golden Baton, a priceless artifact worshipped by your race for eons. It maintains balance and keeps peace in the land, but now it has been stolen from the Palace of King Ferrenuil! Many have searched for it, none have returned. The player will face wolves and crabs, navigate a boat trip, and deal with a magical crystal. Most of the way, you use one object in some way to gain another.
Golden Baton uses the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus has the same features - a basic 2-word parser, limited vocabulary (object names plus standard words such as EXAMINE, WEAR and DROP), and brief descriptions. A Help command is also available which provides hints. Although primitive by later standards, these compare favourably to other interactive fiction of the time.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #02 - The Time Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.60 KB

The Time Machine is the second in the Mysterious Adventure series of text adventures by Brian Howarth. You are a newspaper reporter, come to investigate the eccentric professor who lives all by himself out on the moors. You start the game in a swamp and must find your way to an old manor house. When you get there, you find the place deserted though. Ultimately you must rescue the professor by finding 3 missing prisms which control his time machine, which are lost in time. Items found in one destination sometimes have to be used in another.
As the other games in the series, the game uses an interpreter similar to the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also has the same limitations - a basic 2-word parser, limited vocabulary, and brief descriptions. Illustrations are included in Spectrum, C64, Dragon and Oric ports.

Brian Howarth's second Mysterious Adventure follows on from your success in retrieving the Golden Baton. Peace was initially ensured, but the baton has subsequently become tarnished, and now radiates evil. Crop failures and illness are now rampant throughout the land.
The only solution is to find the Arrow of Death (in this game) and assemble it. Armour, an orb and an eagle are among the helpful objects in completing your quest. The game is largely one of exploration and object manipulation, with little combat.
These games used the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also have the same features - a basic 2-word parser, small vocabulary, and brief descriptions. They were similar to other adventures of the time.

Arrow of Death Part II is the third game in the Mysterious Adventure series of illustrated text adventures by Brian Howarth. This is the continuation of the previous game, Arrow of Death. Following the events of that game, the player now has all of the pieces of the Arrow of Death, which can destroy his enemy. However, the Fletcher who knows how to assemble it correctly has been kidnapped by Xerdon. The player will have to travel through unfamiliar lands with exotic plant-life and many threatening creatures in order to rescue the Fletcher and safeguard your people.
These games used the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also have the same features - a basic 2-word parser, small vocabulary, and brief descriptions. They were similar to other adventures of the time.

Escape From Pulsar 7 is the fourth title in the Mysterious Adventure series of illustrated text adventures by Brian Howarth. It has a science-fiction theme influenced by the hit film "Alien". The player finds themselves trapped alone on a giant space ship. The rest of the crew are dead, killed by a mutated zoo specimen.
The player's goal is ultimately that they must escape the ship in a life pod to avoid being the creature's next meal. Explore the bunks of your comrades to find the tools needed. Only useful items can be taken, so the gameplay is quite linear, with several maze sections.
These games used the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also have the same features - a basic 2-word parser, small vocabulary, and brief descriptions. They were similar to other adventures of the time.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #06 - Circus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.88 KB

The seventh in the Mysterious Adventure series of illustrated text adventures by Brian Howarth. Your car has broken down, miles from anywhere. Heading off in search of a gas station, 3 miles down the road you come upon what appears to be a Circus tent, nestled in a small valley. Sounds and music come from inside. As you reach the gate, suddenly there is complete silence. You walk fearfully towards the entrance of the tent, wondering what exactly is going on here. Maybe if you are lucky, you can find some gas here...
Around this time, the game engine was replaced with a far more powerful one. Now the games accepted complete sentences. You can hit ENTER to switch between graphics and all text. This made them somewhat easier to play and less frustrating.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #07 - Feasibility Experiment
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.43 KB

You have been asked by a dying alien race from across the Universe to search for various amount of treasures scattered around, and return them to save them. In this graphic text adventure you see text describing each location and you can see a picture showing you what each location looks like. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with the locations and control your hero.

The Wizard of Akyrz is the eighth game in the Mysterious Adventures series. The player begins in the royal palace, where the king asks him to save his daughter from an evil wizard. If the player should succeed, his reward will be priceless.
Most instructions are either 90-degree compass moves, or verb-noun commands such as "get painting", "fit chain" or "climb tree". On the player's journey he will discover treasures, which must be stored in a special room, reached via a spell.
The game engine has been redone to allow complete sentences, instead of the two-word Scott Adams parser that was used previously.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.72 KB

Perseus & Andromeda is Number 9 in the Mysterious Adventures series. As the title implies, this one involves Greek mythology involving the characters Perseus and Andromeda. Hero Perseus must slay Medusa and rescue Princess Andromeda who will then become his bride. To accomplish this, he must arm himself with a sword, shield and sandals.
This game follows the Perseus mythology story closely (as seen in the movie "Clash of the Titans" for example). Many puzzles involve giving an object to someone, who then gives Perseus another object. Entering temples and praying can produce plot-advancing events.

Number 10 in the Mysterious Adventures series of interactive fiction is inspired by the Agatha Christie book "And Then There were None". The player's aim is to find the gold statue, formed by Major Johnstone-Smythe from most of his assets shortly before his death. The Major also made 10 worthless copies in various colours, and hid them in and around his mansion. Only the 10 'little indian' figurines, assembled together, would reveal the location of the final golden one. These figurines are hidden behind and under ordinary household objects, and in various hiding places. The game begins in a train carriage and the player's first task is to prevent the train from crashing, which must be achieved in a limited number of moves. Once this has been achieved the train arrives at Lower Massington station and the player must then find their way to the Major's mansion in Upper Massington.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.32 KB

Napoleon at Waterloo is a real-time strategy game which covers the battle of Waterloo (1815).The player controls Napoleon Bonaparte's army and has to defeat the enemy.
At first glance, the game has the distinctive look of a wargame: a top-down map with abstract symbols representing the terrain and units. However, everything is in real-time and therefore the complexity has been toned down. The only thing the player does is giving move orders by choosing a unit and moving the cursor to the place it should move to. Those orders are not carried out instantly; each movement takes a certain amount of time depending on terrain and unit type. Battles are initiated automatically when a unit moves close to a hostile. Then they basically exchange blows until one unit lost all of its soldiers. The game also factors in fatigue and morale.
The time is measured with an in-game clock and a match ends after eleven hours (30 minutes in real-time). If the player has won a match depends on the reached score which is based on the casualties.

Pac-Man, uno de los juegos más populares e influyentes de la década de 1980, está protagonizado por un pequeño comecocos amarillo que se abre camino para limpiar un laberinto de los distintos puntos y frutas que pueblan el tablero.

Durante este tiempo, los fantasmas se vuelven azules y Pac-Man puede comérselos para conseguir puntos extra. Esto solo dura un tiempo limitado, ya que los ojos de los fantasmas flotan de vuelta a su caja central y se regeneran para volver a perseguir a Pac-Man.
Sobrevive a varias rondas de juego y disfruta de divertidos intermedios protagonizados por Pac-Man y los fantasmas.

El objetivo del juego es liquidar a todos los seres dentro del laberinto y encontrar la puerta al siguiente nivel antes de que acabe el tiempo. El jugador solo tiene bombas de tiempo a su disposición y puede usarlas para volar las paredes y matar a los enemigos. Cuando el jugador derriba una parte de la pared, puede  revelar una puerta oculta y elementos de bonus tales como: mayor poder de bomba (icono de trueno), aceleración (icono de S), energía extra (icono de cruz) o pack sorpresa. El contacto con los enemigos y la explosión de la bomba supone una gran pérdida de energía.

El jugador puede moverse hacia la izquierda y hacia la derecha y ajustar la altura. Ahora el jugador tiene la opción de evadir o defenderse. Sin embargo, el Panther sólo puede recibir cinco golpes. Para rescatar a la gente, el jugador debe aterrizar cerca de ellos y esperar hasta que todos estén dentro. Después de llegar al barco de evacuación, el juego vuelve al principio.

Each sector of the planet is filled with deadly radiation; the longer you're there, the more radiation your ship absorbs. A gauge at the bottom of the screen indicates your ship's radiation level, and if it gets too high the ship is destroyed. Shooting these will reduce your ship's radiation level a bit. When you finally reach the end of the sector, you will be returned to the map screen where you can choose another sector and begin exploring again. The game ends when you have lost all of your ships; additional ships can occasionally be found on the planet's surface and are also earned every 5000 points.

Peanut Butter Panic is a game for two players where your goal is to create peanut butter sandwiches! To do this, you need to jump up and grab stars from the top of the screen which can be used to power the sandwich machine. Some stars are too high to reach by just jumping; on either side of the screen is a spring board which can be used to launch your partner higher. After making sandwiches, you can then eat them to replenish your energy supply. Eating sandwiches also makes your character heavier which allows you to launch your partner even higher when jumping on the spring board. On some levels you need to watch out for Snarfs which will eat your sandwiches! The game ends when you run out of energy.

Los enemigos pueden ser aplastados por la caída de rocas, que quedan sueltas cuando se quita el suelo debajo de ellas o se empujan sobre un espacio vacío, pero ten cuidado porque tambien pueden aplastarte a ti. En los niveles más avanzados, la dificultad aumenta añadiendo más rompecabezas y límites de tiempo más cortos.

Phantasie is a classic role-playing game, and one of the first to introduce a "bank" for storing money in addition to expanding on the classic Wizardry-style gameplay of building your own adventuring party with traveling from town to town via the countryside, overhead views of dungeons, and multiple styles of attack.

You will be awarded an extra life for each treasure you get. There is also the winged avenger. This creature does not harm you, but if you are caught in his grasp, he will take you elsewhere in the pyramid. You lose keys when you get carried away by the winged avatar or lose one of your lives. There are three levels. The higher the level, the more treasures you have to get and there are also new chambers. Higher levels require a password, which is revealed after playing the previous level.

Tu objetivo es conseguir la mayor cantidad de dinero posible ganando carreras en el Gran Circuito, que consta de una carrera en cada una de las seis pistas disponibles; Cada vez que se completa una carrera, ganarás dinero según tu posición. Mientras corres, vigila tus neumáticos y el combustible; Si tus neumáticos se desgastan demasiado (provocando un reventón) o te quedas sin combustible, el juego terminará. Pasa por Boxes de vez en cuando para evitarlo. Mientras estás en boxes la carrera continúa, por lo que las reparaciones deben realizarse lo más rápido posible para volver a la carrera sin perder demasiado tiempo. Hay varias opciones de juego disponibles para controlar el nivel de dificultad. Seis circuitos diferentes están disponibles para la carrera, incluidos Brands Hatch y Vallelunga. Las pistas pueden jugarse por separado o todas juntas en un Gran Premio. Los jugadores pueden elegir cuántas vueltas quieren dar y 3 niveles de dificultad diferentes.

Comienzan así varias semanas de intensa exploración, maniobras políticas, sabotajes y adjudicación de concesiones que decidirán el curso de la explotación económica del espacio exterior durante los próximos cien años.

Los lobos disparan bellotas a la cerda. Pero la Sra. Cerda también tiene un arma basada en comida. Si llega a la cima, puede conseguir carne para lanzársela a los lobos y hacer que salten de sus globos para perseguirla. Cada lobo eliminado de esta manera vale puntos de bonificación.

Como Popeye, tienes que ganarte el amor de Olive Oyl. Ella está en la parte superior de la pantalla dejando caer fichas de su amor, y tienes que recogerlas antes de que caigan al suelo. Cuando hayas recogido el número necesario de objetos, podrás pasar al siguiente nivel, más difícil. Sin embargo, ¡hay muchos obstáculos que intentarán impedir que completes tu tarea! Brutus deambula por la pantalla e intenta atraparte constantemente. Si recoges una lata de espinacas, puedes noquearlo temporalmente; de lo contrario, Brutus te noqueará a ti. Otros objetos, como botellas o pájaros, también vuelan por la pantalla y te harán perder una de tus vidas si te golpean. Cada nivel presenta una disposición diferente de plataformas y escaleras, y te hará recoger distintos objetos mientras flotan hacia el fondo de la pantalla.

meta.name: Power Down
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.59 KB

The task in Power Down is to infiltrate a fortress built on an asteroid by the evil Argon, inside a one-hour time limit. You have five ships, but there are many ways to lose one. Lazer beams and triangular rays toggle on and off, so require timing and planning to avoid. Argoniks patrol the area, and are fatal to the touch - however, they can work in your favour, as they activate some types of indestructible blocks on contact, changing the blocks' frames from white to red as a signal to you. Most doors are closed by default, and are activated by firing into their brown covers. They can be closed in the same way - this is a defensive tactic to block Argoniks, but make sure you are not in the way of the door as it closes. You can collect and activate shields to deflect and block various hazards - although the ultimate challenge is to complete the game without them.

meta.name: Montezuma's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.44 KB

En Montezuma's Revenge eres un cazador de tesoros llamado Panama Joe, cuyo objetivo es encontrar un antiguo tesoro escondido por un guerrero azteca en lo mas profundo de las catacumbas. Pero ojo, las catacumbas son un laberinto habitado por horribles monstruos. Te esperan calaveras que rebotan y ruedan, arañas, cadenas que desaparecen y fuegos. Tendrás que encontrar las llaves y desbloquear las puertas para lograr tu objetivo. Panama Joe puede saltar y subir escaleras, pero no tiene mucho que ofrecer en cuanto a combate. Es por eso que debes evitar los monstruos en el juego: una colisión con un enemigo provoca la muerte inmediata.

meta.name: Preppie!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.68 KB

Preppie! is a variant of Frogger that takes place on the toughest golf course in the world, the Ninenty Nine, where the player has to retrieve his golf balls. The player starts at the bottom part of the screen and has to traverse first a road full of golf carts, bulldozers and lawn mowers and then a river full of logs and alligators. Each level has one or more golf balls that the player has to pick up and carry back to the starting position. He can only carry one ball at a time so he has to move past the dangers multiple times before a level is completed. Points are earned for each golf ball recovered. As the player progresses through the levels more and more threats are introduced, such as monster frogs and new types of vehicles. There are ten levels in total.

meta.name: Preppie! II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.87 KB

Preppie II continues the adventures of Wadsworth Overcash. Up and coming prepester Wadsworth thought he had it all, until an initiation stunt gone wrong left him in trouble with the top fraternity on campus. After barely escaping his banishment retrieving balls from a golf course of hellish design in Preppie!, Wadsworth must now compete in a new challenge to advance to the next level of fraternity consideration. Wadsworth is armed with a cloak which makes him invulnerable to enemy attack for a a limited period of time each level. Each level of difficulty consists of 3 rooms separated by a doorway. The goal is to walk over all areas of the map to turn them purple. When all squares are colored in all 3 rooms, the player advances to the next level. Room 1 and 3 features frogs which continuously try to hop towards the player. They can be avoided by using spinning doors to block the frogs' path. The 2nd room features several horizontal passageways, from which lawnmowers continuously scroll from the left or the right. The player must use interconnecting pathways to avoid this danger.

Hitting an object throws you off your bike and wastes time and the winner is the person who finishes the course in the fastest time.

Once the entire population is safely removed and are registered into New Hope, then they are placed into the Verdann Fortress. As the last citizen has been placed there, the gates of Verdann Fortress can be closed against both the Hordes, and the Volcano. The lava flows engulf the city of New Hope.

También tienes que rescatar humanos (dos veces) tanto de una nave alienígena, como más tarde de una ciudad que será invadida por lava de un volcán que entra en erupción durante el juego; todo el tiempo protegiéndolos de los alienígenas. Luego tienes que dejarlos caer uno a la vez (a diferencia de Defender, solo puedes llevar un humano a la vez) en un tubo teletransportador para sacarlos completamente del planeta. El juego es bastante difícil, con un vuelo muy preciso requerido a veces (probablemente incluso más difícil que Defender o Stargate).

Q*bert is a popular arcade game. The goal is to change all of the tiles on a pyramid to the target color. To do this you guide Q*bert around the pyramid, and every tile he hops on will change color. On early levels, a single hop will change the tile to the desired color, but on later levels you may need to hop on a tile multiple times or even avoid hopping on a tile multiple times! Trying to stop Q*bert are many different creatures which wander around the board, including Coily the snake, Slick and Sam, and falling balls. On the edge of the board are floating discs; if Q*bert jumps on one of these discs when the snake is in pursuit, the snake will fall off the board while Q*bert is safely transported to the top.

In this game, you guide a marker which must draw rectangles and other weird objects in order to claim your territory, and you can either draw these rectangles fast or slow. While drawing the rectangles, you need to watch out for Qix (pronounced "kicks"), a series of colored lines that crawl the screen. In addition to Qix, you also need to avoid the Sparks who travel around the border, as well as any lines that you have made, as well as The Fuse, who travels along the line that you are drawing. Once you have claimed enough territory, you proceed to the next level.

meta.name: Quasimodo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.61 KB

A hunchback atop a wall, is under siege  by a man in armour climbing up a ladder. He, can fight with a rock from a pile, hurling down at the intruder. But another and another are set up. Yet as soon, all is quiet once more, your companion an endlessly-flapping bat, who kills you should he absentmindedly drift into your path. The game shifts gears here, the joystick's action button to jumping. No other humans while you scurry up ladders and swing yourself across ropes dangling from massive ceiling-mounted bells, all in pursuit of gleaming gems to deposit in basement altars. Every time you do so another area of the game will be opened up, and you get to undertake the grand circuit once more, again fending off the ladder-climbers, swinging across the same pits, dodging the same bats. At the very pinnacle of your medieval structure you will have to climb a sheer wall face while dodging arrows shot by archers in the window and boulders rolled down from the parapets. And then the gem is got, and back down again, and so forth and so on; the cycle turns on. An endless labour...

El juego te lleva a tu hangar, desde donde debes lanzar rápidamente tantas naves como sea posible, una tarea dificultada por la gravedad limitada. Luego debes volarla hacia el espacio aéreo soviético en una sección de shoot 'em up de vista lateral, en la que permanecer bajo te mantiene a salvo de los radares, y las reacciones rápidas te permiten derribar cazas enemigos y evitar árboles. This game is about a baby owl tasked with coloring of the rainbow high above the clouds. The owl navigates the playfield by jumping back, forward, left or right, one square at a time, coloring them in the process. Some squares are in fact gaping holes and jumping on those will send the owl tumbling down to his death. The only way to escape the gruesome fate is clever avoidance. As the game progresses, not only does the shape of the rainbow become narrower and trickier, with more dead ends and pitfalls, but also the speed and number of the enemies increases.

Romper los bordes de los edificios el tiempo suficiente los hará colapsar. La policía y el ejército te persiguen y te dispararán, así que intenta destruirlos. Necesitarás comer regularmente, con cosas como las plantas que se te ofrecen, para evitar volver a ser humano.

"Mike Edwards' Realm of Impossibility" also known as "Zombies", is a platform game in which the protagonist has to fight the titular monsters, snakes, spiders, and an array of other creatures in order to survive. The dungeons the hero must traverse make use of visual effects, similar to those found in M. C. Escher's work, to create physically impossible scenarios. A cooperative mode with another player is also included.

meta.name: Realsports Tennis

Antes de que comience el juego, los jugadores deben nombrar su personaje y elegir entre el modo de uno o dos jugadores y los dos niveles de dificultad preestablecidos ("lento" y "rápido").
En el juego, un jugador con una camiseta azul juega al tenis contra un enemigo de la IA representado por un personaje no jugador (NPC) con una camiseta roja. En el modo de dos jugadores, un jugador compite contra otro jugador local. Los jugadores pueden moverse vertical y horizontalmente en el mapa. Con un botón en el controlador Atari, los jugadores realizan el servicio. Cada nuevo tiro es automático si el balón tiene contacto físico con el jugador. Por cada pelota que cae en el campo de juego contrario, los jugadores obtienen 15 puntos que pueden ver en la parte superior de la pantalla. Después de alcanzar los 30 puntos, solo obtienen 10 puntos por cada bola. Después de 40 puntos, ganaron una ronda. El número de rondas ganadas aumenta a 6. Después de ganar 6 rondas, se abre una nueva pila en la parte superior de la pantalla que vuelve a subir a 6. El primer jugador que ganó dos pilas de 6 rondas gana el juego.

meta.name: Rebel Charge at Chickamauga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 84.34 KB

Rebel Charge at Chickamauga is a tactical simulation of the South's last major offensive thrust during the American Civil War. 
The game uses a refined version of SSI's Gettysburg game system and is played in 13 turns each representing two hours of real time over a two day period. Players are awarded points based on casualties and territorial objectives. At the end of each turn and the end of the game points are calculated and compared to a chart which determines your level of victory. The game can be played under 3 different sets of rules (Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced) and can be played against another person or the computer can play either side.

meta.name: Red Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.59 KB

En aquellos tiempos antiguos, la luz de la Luna era el medio de toda la magia de la Tierra. Perdió casi toda su fuerza. A partir de entonces, su débil luz ya no fue suficiente para garantizar la continuidad de los antiguos hechizos. Comprendiendo el peligro, los magos más poderosos unieron sus fuerzas y crearon uno nuevo: el cristal de luna roja... Pero el reino cayó en la barbarie y la luz del cristal se extinguió. Debes encontrar el famoso cristal para restaurar el antiguo Conocimiento. Durante tu búsqueda, podrás hacerte con nueve tesoros y tendrás a tu disposición una serie de hechizos que te serán útiles para obtener información o combatir. Cada hechizo cuesta una parte de tu capital mágico, que debes restaurar. Para luchar contra criaturas agresivas, es mejor tener un arma y una armadura de antemano.

Un shoot 'em up de desplazamiento lateral inspirado en Defender, pero que añade mucho al concepto. Vuelas a través de un paisaje que se desplaza horizontalmente en bucle con el objetivo de proteger tu base. Hay un total de ocho enemigos en pantalla en cualquier momento. Los Quarriers intentan construir la base enemiga robando partes de la tuya. Los Drayns te roban energía y luego se la suministran al enemigo. Afortunadamente, puedes recuperar la energía que te quitan, pero no puedes recuperar las partes de tu base. Los otros seis enemigos solo intentan matarte. Cuanto más grande se vuelve la base enemiga, más rápido y con mayor precisión pueden lanzarte enemigos.

Your mission is to rescue stranded pilots on the planet of Fractalus. You begin each mission from the mother ship, and when your quota of pilots has been rescued you must return there so you can move on to the next level. To help locate the pilots and navigate the tricky terrain, your spaceship is equipped with various instruments, such as a compass, altimeter, and scanner. Your enemy, the Jaggi's, have numerous forces on this planet and will be attempting to stop you. Gun emplacements, flying saucers, and the Jaggi themselves are all capable of destroying your ship if you don't destroy them first. As the levels progress, the Jaggi defenses become more aggressive, and you will even need to fly some night missions where visibility is limited.

Snowball's robot commanders want to colonize the planet Eden. You control Commander Kim Kimberley, a fugitive accused of murder and must flee and survive in a spaceship as well as a robot city.

Revenge II, Jeff Minter's third camel-themed game (after Attack and Revenge) is again a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up, taking place over 100 levels. 6,000 years ago, mankind fought the forces of Zzyax, using mutated forms of common animals. Now, the Zzyaxians are back, and the 90-foot camels must defend a planet no longer accustomed to warfare.
The Zzyaxian hordes consist of typical Minter zaniness. Postboxes and letters, Pacman ghosts and microchips are all out to get you. The game allows you to fire in any direction, by moving the joystick while holding down the fire button. Additionally, you can drop miniature versions of yourself, as bombs.
After completing a level or losing a life, the player can move to a level adjacent to the current one within a 10x10 grid. You can also purchase improved shields, energy recharges, or improved weaponry such as bigger or 'smart' bullets.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.62 KB

Everyone's in a carnival spirit - especially one rambunctious monkey named Thymus. He's stealing the show by scampering all around the big tent. He hops on the backs of marching elephants or camels... you guide Thymus where he wants to go, and you make sure he jumps successfully. He'll make it if he always leaps onto the back of an elephant or camel numbered with the multiple of the number he started from at the bottom of the screen.

meta.name: River Raid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.29 KB

River Raid es un juego de acción de desplazamiento vertical. Vuelas en un jet por un río en un intento de destruir los puentes que son vitales para el enemigo. Sin embargo, el río está fuertemente custodiado, con globos, barcos, helicópteros y aviones enemigos que intentan detenerte. En el camino tendrás que volar sobre las estaciones de combustible para repostar el avión y seguir volando.
El avión está armado con un cañón con munición ilimitada. Se puede utilizar para destruir los vehículos enemigos y puentes, pero un jugador descuidado puede destruir accidentalmente una estación de combustible. Chocar con los margenes del río o con un avión enemigo destruye tu avión y te hace perder una vida.

meta.name: Robbo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.98 KB

The game's design was partly inspired by Boulder Dash, but with the gravity aspect removed. 
The player controls the titular little robot through a series of planets (56 in the original Atari version), each being a vertically-scrolling maze filled with various objects and obstacles. The goal of each level is to collect a preset number of bolts scattered around (there could be extra bolts on the map, and bolts could also be acquired from random item generators), and then reach a capsule that takes the hero to the next planet. On his way Robbo must avoid deadly obstacles that include moving creatures, laser turrets, and large magnets. Various items can be found, including keys that open doors, bullets that kill enemies and destroy impassable walls of rubble, crates that can be pushed, bombs that explode upon being shot, and mirrors that teleport the hero around the level.

meta.name: The Adventures of Robin Hood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.43 KB

Robin Hood is at it again. In this side-scrolling action game he has to use his bow to vanquish the troops of evil Sheriff, collect treasure and kiss the beautiful Maid Marian. The only location featured in the game is Sherwood's Forest. However, enemies respawn so there's no lack of things to shoot. Robin Hood can also climb anything that is of brown color.

meta.name: Robotron : 2084
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.58 KB

Eres un humano mutante que, por alguna rareza de la naturaleza, tiene la capacidad de disparar pulsos de energía desde su cuerpo en ocho direcciones diferentes. Tu trabajo es simple: salvar a la humanidad de su propia creación: ¡los ROBOTRONS! La jugabilidad es bastante única para la época. Puedes moverte y disparar en cualquiera de las ocho direcciones. Te lanzan a una habitación con varios enemigos malvados esparcidos por todas partes, tienes que matar a todos los robots y al mismo tiempo encontrar alguna manera de agarrar a los humanos y evitar la muerte.

meta.name: Rock 'n' Rhythm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.61 KB

Did you ever dream of becoming a recording star? Or wonder what it would be like to walk into a studio and tape a hit song? Well now you can stop dreaming and start recording because Rock 'N Rhythm makes it all a reality. 
You now own your own recording studio. You have a full set of drums and a bass keyboard. You can be the recording engineer Someone else can be musicians. And a third person can be the writer of hit music. Or you can be all three by yourself. It's up to you.
Once you've created a song, you can store it in your jukebox and play it back with the touch of a few buttons. You can even store your musical collection for later performances. 
Want to change your song? Go ahead.
Make it faster. Make it slower. Or do other things to make it even better.
Because with Rock 'N' Rhythm, you're the star and you call the shots.

Los enemigos son formas abstractas que se mueven en manadas, pululando por la pantalla siguiendo patrones específicos mientras el jugador intenta golpearlos. Una vez que un enjambre ha sido eliminado, hay otro que ocupa su lugar. El jugador tiene tres vidas al principio y gana nuevas después de completar cada pocos niveles.

Salmon Run

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.54 KB

The story of the determined salmon, struggling upstream to spawn every season, takes a slightly different twist in Salmon Run. The mighty little fish struggles upstream, fighting bears, waterfalls, and sea gulls. But is it all for naught? Does he merely die in the end? Now his fate lies in your hands.

meta.name: Saper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.33 KB

Saper is a two-dimensional platform game with elements of puzzle-solving. The story tells of a criminal organization, which managed to steal important NATO documents. CIA agents have failed to recover the documents, therefore the authorities decide to blow up the headquarters of criminals. The building has many explosives installed. The player has to destroy all the bombs which are visible on the screen and then reach an exit point. Some of the bombs and exits are not easily reachable. To get access to them it is necessary to move some tiles too. The basis for the completion of the mission is the order of detonation explosive devices. There are tiles which have unique purposes. An additional difficulty is the time limit, to pass each of the 64 levels of the game authors dedicate 120 seconds. The player will face as well disappearing tiles, exploding mines or surfaces of ice that move the player to the first no ice area. In contrast, the expanding plant, the detonator of all bombs or the teleport should greatly facilitate the task.

meta.name: Saratoga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.65 KB

Saratoga: revolutionary war strategic board game ... you control the American forces and attempt to foil the British as they try to divide the colonies. The game is fairly complex, and it's recommended that you read all the instructions before attempting to play it. Otherwise, you may become disillusioned and frustrated by the rules.

meta.name: Satan's Hollow

¡Un diabólico juego de batalla nuevo! Detén a los gárgolas que pululan. Construye el Puente de Fuego. Cuando la noche comience a caer, cruza hacia el valle para derrotar al Maestro de la Oscuridad.

meta.name: Adventure #10 - Savage Island Part One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.52 KB

Savage Island es el único juego de varias partes de la serie de aventuras de Scott Adams, todas ellas con un parser y una interfaz muy similares. Al final de este juego, los jugadores reciben una contraseña que les permite jugar la segunda parte. Los juegos de Savage Island son también probablemente las aventuras más difíciles de la serie.
El jugador comienza atrapado en una pequeña isla en el océano, que se enfrenta a un huracán y también tiene un volcán activo. El jugador puede cruzar un río y también tendrá que explorar una red de cuevas. Los objetos se suelen encontrar recorriendo la arena con las manos.
La isla guarda un gran secreto, que sólo se descubrirá cuando se terminen las dos partes del juego.

meta.name: Adventure #11 - Savage Island Part Two
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.76 KB

The second half of Savage Island, this continues exactly where the other game leaves off. It includes a mysterious code sheet which you will be able to decipher upon completing the game, revealing the ultimate secret of the island.

meta.name: Schreckenstein
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.98 KB

The castle of Schreckenstein has been taken over by black sorcerers and creatures of the underworld. The magical eyes of the Necropolis ward off visitors to the castle, but it might just be possible for one or two brave souls to enter the castle dungeons. And with the help of the white sorcerers, perhaps they can restore peace to the castle. Schreckenstein is a platform maze game designed to be played by two players, with each player's surroundings shown in either the top or bottom half of the screen. If a single player is selected, the computer operates the second player. In each level, the players must traverse the maze collecting health elixirs and level specific objects while avoiding spooks, bats, spiders and miscellaneous traps. Each player can throw a weapon to dispatch their enemies.

meta.name: Scramble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.54 KB

El jugador debe pilotar su nave a través de un terreno de desplazamiento lateral mediante seis niveles únicos. Cada nivel presenta sus propios desafíos y obstáculos, como objetivos terrestres, cohetes, tanques de combustible, platillos voladores y meteoritos. El jugador debe evitar o destruir estos peligros mientras administra el combustible limitado de la nave. El objetivo es llegar al final del nivel y destruir la base enemiga, intentando obtener la mayor puntuación posible.

meta.name: Screaming Wings
meta.desc:

Un shoot 'em up de desplazamiento vertical de arriba hacia abajo con una sensación de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que se asemeja a 1942. Pilotas tu avión a través de 9 niveles de bosques, campos y océanos. Te enfrentarás a hordas de aviones enemigos y sus balas, cuyo contacto te cuesta una de tus 3 vidas. Puedes salir ligeramente de la pantalla para esquivar balas, de forma similar a SWIV. Hay una serie de potenciadores disponibles, incluida un arma no tripulada que disparará desde la posición opuesta a la tuya (por ejemplo, si estás al 75% del ancho de la pantalla, estará al 25% del ancho).

meta.name: Sea Dragon
meta.desc:

Sea Dragon es un shooter arcade de desplazamiento lateral. El jugador pilota un submarino a través de amenazadoras cuevas submarinas para destruir un reactor fuertemente custodiado. Minas, torretas y una gran variedad de enemigos son los obstáculos para alcanzar este objetivo. El submarino está armado con misiles, torpedos y un arma "Big Kill" (que afecta a todo lo que aparece en la pantalla) para ayudar al jugador en el éxito de la misión. Con suministros de aire limitados, el jugador debe salir a la superficie para reponer aire siempre que sea posible.

The seahorse can hide in tunnels, automatically bringing the seahorse to a different location. However, there is always an octopus hiding in a cave. The seahorse can also hide in corals, as long as they match the seahorse's colour.

When you picked up all your treasures you may pick up anti-ship missile to sink the destroyer and advance to next level.

meta.name: Serpentine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.34 KB

In Serpentine you control a multi-segmented snake in a maze; your goal is to survive and earn as many points as possible. At the beginning of each level, three enemy snakes will also enter the maze. To complete the level, you need to eat all of the enemy snakes. If an enemy snake has more segments than your snake, you can only eat segments that form the tail of the snake; a collision with the head is lethal! Each time you eat a segment, the enemy snake will become smaller until eventually you can devour it completely. For enemy snakes that have fewer segments than you, you can eat the tail segments or the head segment. From time to time, a frog will appear in the maze; eating this will cause your snake to grow. Both your snake and enemy snakes will leave eggs behind occasionally; left alone, these will hatch (your eggs earn you an extra life, enemy eggs will hatch another snake). Eggs can also be eaten to remove them from the playfield, so it's usually a good idea to eat enemy eggs before a new snake hatches! The maze changes for each level, and the enemy snakes progressively become larger and tougher to catch.

meta.name: Sesame Street : Letter-Go-Round
Seven Card Stud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.86 KB

Seven Card Stud simulates five card-playing partners with four programmable characteristics each. You can also use the preprogrammed personalities, which are quite challenging. Once you've completed a hand, Seven Card Stud lets you go back and see everyone's cards for study.

meta.name: The Seven Cities of Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 66.16 KB

In The Seven Cities of Gold the player takes on the role of Christopher Columbus and the later Spanish conquistadors, exploring the New World (or a randomly generated map). As the player establishes forts and missions, bringing back gold to Spain, he or she would receive promotions from the Queen of Spain. 
The game features a large world to explore and comes up with some arcade sequences to simulate the interaction of the Natives and Spanish who did not speak the same language. The historical map accurately spreads out the Native population of the New World in 1492 and some historical situations can be simulated, such as whether to get the gold of the Aztec and Incas by trade or conquest.

meta.name: Shadow World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.31 KB

Shadow World es un shooter de desplazamiento lateral en su mayor parte. Las naves de cristal Rigillian descienden lentamente del cielo y solo pueden ser derrotadas si se destruye su núcleo central usando los cañones plasmatrónicos de tu interceptor. Estas naves de cristal despliegan un skimmer, que recupera tricasmio de la superficie, permitiendo que las naves desciendan de forma segura.

meta.name: Shamus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.49 KB

Infiltrate the lair of the elusive Shadow and hunt him down before he does the same to you. Starring in the titular role of Shamus, you will have to find your way through over 120 rooms in this cross between Berzerk's "robots in a maze" action and Adventure's exploration of a predefined game world. The elusive villain's henchmen will express their disapproval of your plans in rather strong terms, namely with showers of bullets. What's more, once they're dead they don't necessarily stay that way: each time a room is re-entered, a random selection of them will respawn. The Shadow has also arranged for electrified walls throughout his compound, so bumping into them will prove quite lethal. The labyrinth of chambers is divided into four levels, with multiple locked doors that'll have you wandering around in search of the right keys. If you tarry too long in the same room, a bulletproof Shadow will drop by to discourage loitering.

meta.name: Shamus - Case II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.78 KB

ou play Shamus, a sort of detective and dungeon-crawling adventurer in one. In a previous game, you managed to get your bad guy, but now he has escaped, and you must go into his underground lair to bring him back. Getting through the game means surviving the traps and monsters spread throughout the dungeon. You must also get past the wrong turns. To get by the monsters, you must either avoid them, or use a weapon (limited shots). Throughout the dungeon are treasure chests, cache's of useful things, such as keys and hints.

meta.name: Shanghai
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.04 KB

The gameplay involves 144 tiles, each depicting different images, which have to be removed by matching them into pairs. The tiles are arranged in a gridded pattern, which is higher near the centre. A tile can only be removed if it has no tile next to it on at least one side.
This computer implementation can generate a random board layout to take on and features five preset challenges, some of which have time limits of five or ten minutes, as well as a multiplayer mode.

meta.name: Sidewinder II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.24 KB

INITIAL BREFING: Long range detectors are sensing a huge mass approaching from the direction of the aliens homeworld. Initial reports from remote scouts indicate it to be a massive battle station, many times larger than "Star Killer", the ship you destroyed 27 years ago in the mission that brought peace. The "Sidewinder" mission. Computer selection, after many considerations, has chosen you as the only possible candidate for the second Sidewinder mission. The mission will begin when we have obtained more data.
BRIEFING UPDATE: Covert intelligence report a possible weak point has been found. Access to the alien battle station is via a tunnel used to vent any excess energy. Lining the tunnel are defensive positions which may be destroyed. There are also a large number of venting doors. These automatically open and close and cannot be destroyed. They must be avoided. Finally, manteinance and defence drones patrol the ducts watching for faults and space scavengers. To help you, extra weaponry will be 'ported' in so you must watch out for these and collect them. The extra weaponry includes lasers and multi shots.

meta.name: Sidewinder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.26 KB

Sidewinder es un shooter de desplazamiento lateral. El jugador asume el papel del único superviviente de un equipo de agentes enviados a capturar el helicóptero Sidewinder. Como piloto, el jugador debe escapar a través de las cavernas custodiadas por un sistema de seguridad enemigo.

meta.name: Silent Service
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.00 KB

Silent Service es una simulación de submarinos. Asumes el papel de un miembro de las fuerzas submarinas americanas y estás a cargo del contraataque contra Japón. Con diferentes niveles de realismo, y por tanto de dificultad, controla parámetros como la profundidad máxima, los torpedos, etc. El juego cuenta con un modo Campaña, además de los modos Entrenamiento y Misión Individual, que te permitirán ganar experiencia mientras te mantengas con vida.

meta.name: Silicon Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.90 KB

Make a time journey into the year 2084. The SYBORGS, a superhuman race of Technocrates, developed a computer of the 10th generation. A computer with more RAM and more artificial intelligence as all other computers built by the mankind. The SYBORGS swore to tell the secret, which is connected with this computer, to the best and greatest computer developer of the mankind. The managers of all prominent computer companies sent their best developers to this future war. They have to fight against each other. One against the other one. Only the best can experience the secret of the SYBORGS. The game was ported to the C64 in 1984.

meta.name: Skull Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.92 KB

"Mystified, you wake to find yourself half buried beneath the sands of a strange and vast island. Looking seaward, your eyes gaze upon the remains of your wrecked ship. As you struggle to recall the past events that brought you to this seemingly tropical paradise, your hazy memory pinpoints only a violent storm at sea and your attempts to keep your once-seaworthy vessel afloat. Certain only that you are somewhere in the South Pacific, you climb to your feet, trying to get a bearing on your present location. Suddenly, your eyes fall upon a wooden board lying on the beach some yards away. As you approach it, you realize it is some kind of sign. Brushing away the sand from the rotting wood, you reveal the words 'Welcome to Skull Island.' Your pulse quickens as you realize the meaning behind these words. In legend, many attempted to sail to Skull island to discover the magic it possessed, but no man ever returned from his adventure. The sounds of the jungle surround you. Destiny calls. You set out to escape Skull Island - or die trying." - Analog Computing 77 pg.59

meta.name: Sky Blazer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.38 KB

Also known a "Star Blazer" is a side-scrolling shooter similar in style to Konami's Super Cobra. You are a fighter pilot on several hazardous missions. In each level you have to fulfill one mission like bomb the radar, destroy the tank etc. The scenery as buildings and warehouses and airborne objects as jets and rockets can all destroy your jet. Your fighter jet is armed with a limited supply of bullets for a on board machine gun and with bombs, also with limited supply. Bombs can only be dropped from very low altitude. Furthermore, your jet has a limited amount of fuel which can be refueled by picking up a parachute dropped out of another plane.

meta.name: Sleazy Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.37 KB

You suspect you might be going under when your bank starts foreclosing on your home and all your creditors are asking to be invited for a sail. A rich sailing buddy has recently purchased a sixty-foot cutter, currently moored in Thailand. You volunteer to sail it home for her, thinking you can bring back a little contraband while you're at it.

meta.name: Slime
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.03 KB

En Slime, el jugador controla una pequeña nave de guerra que se mueve horizontalmente por la parte inferior de la pantalla. Está rodeada por un Absorber a cada lado de la parte inferior de la pantalla. Las naves alienígenas dejarán caer limos desde el cielo, y el jugador debe disparar barricadas en forma de cuña, con la esperanza de dirigir los limos hacia los Absorbers, o al menos impedir que lleguen al mar. Mientras haces esto, naves alienígenas taponarán intermitentemente tus Absorbers, o derribarán tus cuñas. A medida que los limos lleguen al océano, el nivel del mar subirá, y cuando el mar alcance la parte superior de la pantalla, se acabó el juego.

meta.name: Slingshot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.96 KB

You control a ball with the aim to hit a number of targets on each screen in the least number of shots. You can control the direction, power and electrical charge of the ball. Each screen contains a number of electrical charges, knowing that alike charges attract and that hitting most objects will slow the ball, the key to the game is to use the electrical charges to "slingshot" the ball. This is similar to the way a spacecraft will use planet's gravity to change direction. A course consists of ten scores.

meta.name: Smasher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.57 KB

Defend your empire by smashing enemy spacecraft. The Vorpons, enemies from a neighboring galaxy, are swarming through your empire's intergalactic port. Their goal: to destroy the empire. You control the most colossal weapon ever devised -- the Smasher! It's your only defense against the Vorpon attacks. Activate it, crush their tiny craft into oblivion, and save the Empire!

meta.name: The Snapper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.83 KB

The Snapper is a 1 or 2-player arcade maze game.
The player controls the arrow-like Snapper, which follows a series of purple dotted lines. The goal is to collect a specific number of blots on each stage before returning to one of the 4 bases. On early stages, no blots are required, but as difficulty progresses, more blots are required to complete a level. The player always starts in the middle of the stage, and must avoid the flashing Gamma Field which flits around the screen. In addition, Whirlers follow the purple lines, but destroy the trail behind them, constantly changing the maze. The player loses a life if they contact a Whirler or Gamma Field. There are also thickened blue lines, which allow the player to move at double speed, but they can not exit from the blue line until reaching the end.

meta.name: Steve Davis Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.18 KB

Mike Lamb recreated the basic rules of the popular English game of snooker in this simulation, which can be played by one or two players, but has no computer opponent as such, unlike the later 16-bit remake.
Instead, you are scored based not only on how many points you score legitimately, but also on how many points you concede through foul shots, and how many shots you take in total. You always take the next shot, even if you've missed or fouled, so in a one player game the break-building strategies can be slightly more aggressive than in a real match, as there's no risk of leaving an opponent a chance.

meta.name: Snowball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.54 KB

Snowball 9 was sent to Colonize Eridani A, with robots sent to prepare the territory around 100 years before human beings arrive, but something went wrong en route. Commander Kim Kimberley became aware of this when she was abruptly awoken from hibernation.
Snowball is an interactive fiction game, which uses compression techniques to provide 7000 rooms in computers of this size. Kim must go from her hibernation chamber to the ship controls, and then work them to guide the ship safely to Eridani. Commands like INVENTORY, EXAMINE, TAKE and USE are available. Objects include a drinks machine, a bed, green foam, Kevlar and a silver tray.

meta.name: SoftSide Adventure of the Month 14 : Robin Hood
SoftSide Adventure of the Month 19 : Alaskan Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.91 KB

Alaskan Adventure is the nineteenth a series of monthly text adventures for multiple systems. You're in Alaska, standing in the snow. Around you, fifteen treasures are hidden. Some are buried in the snow, others are cached in nearby igloos. Some are in even stranger places, and you will need considerable ingenuity to get them. The player must travel to 8 separate frozen areas via dogsled. The player's goal is to return all the items to the trading post, and many of the items are found in local snow drifts or stolen from the nearby Inuit community. Along the way, the player's dogsled team will often break down, requiring the player to feed them, get them water, or treat their illness to continue to the next area. All commands are via 2-word VERB NOUN entries, and game play contains several object puzzles. There is no save and restore feature.

meta.name: Soko-Ban
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.71 KB

Soko-Ban is a classic puzzle game, the basis of numerous clones in the later years. It is set in a warehouse. On each level, the player must push crates (from square to square) to get them onto designated spots; once each crate is on a marked spot, the level is complete. Crates can only be pushed one at a time (so two crates next to each other cannot be pushed together), and cannot be pulled--so it's possible to get a crate stuck in a corner, where it cannot be retrieved! By the last levels, you must plan 40 steps in advance.

meta.name: Sons of Liberty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 101.62 KB

Three of the key battles of the American War of Independence are recreated here. The British army and American patriots can be played by either human or computer (with 3 skill levels). Each side's level of reinforcements and ammunition can be set on a 5-point scale. The smallest and shortest battle is Bunker Hill, while the Battle of Monmouth is distinguished by harsh weather, and Saratoga requires a different fighting style to the highly regimented one the British unsuccessfully used.

meta.name: Sorcerer of Claymorgue Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 75.37 KB

Number 13 in the Adventure series from Scott Adams, and the first which was never released in all-text format (except for BBC, Electron, Dragon and TRS-80 versions). Solon, the Master Wizard has lost the 13 Stars of Power. It is up to you, his faithful apprentice, to retrieve them from Claymorgue Castle.
This is similar to the other SAGA games in the series. Additionally, there is some use of magic of course!
